summary: Frontend-only E2E testing (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080) of the 3 new enhancements: per-course firing in POS, debt credit-limit warning, promo time-window scheduling, plus regressions. All three features work end-to-end. Found 1 HIGH data-loss bug in Admin > Клиенты (credit_limit not prefilled on edit -> silently reset to 0) and a few UX/minor issues. Backend skipped per request; state restored after testing (client debt 0, credit_limit 50, no open orders, seeded promo intact).

ui_bugs.issue: Edit button builds form without credit_limit ({id,name,phone,discount_percent,loyalty_group_id}), so 'Лимит долга' shows 0 even when DB has 50, and save() sends credit_limit: Number(form.credit_limit || 0) -> any client edit silently wipes the credit limit. Verified live: DB=50, modal='0', after save DB=0.

tickets-close-btn calls backToTables() -> after firing a single course, closing the ticket modal exits the order and clears the cart; cashier must re-open the bill from the table to fire the next course. Breaks the intended per-course flow (other courses should stay editable in place).
Modal has no Escape/keyboard close handler; overlay (fixed inset-0 z-50) intercepts all clicks until X/overlay is clicked. Minor a11y/UX gap.

saveComment() only PUTs when store.orderId exists; on a brand-new unsaved order the comment (and the whole cart) lives only in local state, so leaving the order loses it. Observed: items+comment added on Стол 3 were not persisted server-side until send/pay.

issues: 'Греческий салат' ticket prints to 'ЦЕХ: Бар' while burgers go to 'ЦЕХ: Кухня' — seeded printer/station routing for the Салаты category looks wrong (cosmetic/demo data)

action_items: Fix Clients.jsx: include credit_limit (and keep other fields) when opening the edit modal — e.g. setForm({...c}) — otherwise every client edit resets 'Лимит долга' to 0 (unlimited).
Consider keeping the cashier inside the order after closing the kitchen-tickets modal following a per-course fire (don't call backToTables from tickets-close-btn).
Optional: persist the order (saveOrder) when a comment is added so comments on unsaved orders aren't lost; add Escape-to-close to the admin Modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Clients.jsx line ~88: edit handler omits credit_limit -> combined with save() defaulting to 0 this is silent data loss on unrelated edits (HIGH).

Credit-limit enforcement is frontend-only by design; note that a POS client with a stale cached /clients?phone response could bypass the check — acceptable given warn+override design, but backend has no guard at all.
Pos.jsx is ~1066 lines; consider splitting cart/checkout/modals into sub-components per the 700-line guideline.
seed_data_creation: Temp promo 'TEST_Обед -20%' created and deleted; orders on Стол 1-4 created and paid (cash + debt); client 'Иван Петров' debt repaid and credit_limit restored to 50.
test_credentials: Manager admin@resto.com/admin123; POS PIN 2222 (admin), 1111 (waiter) — all worked
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS: (1) course grouping headers course-header-1/2 + fire-course-N; fire-course-1 sent ONLY course 1 (ticket 'Подача 1 / Греческий салат'), item badge 'отправлено', fire button disappears, course 2 still fireable; global send-kitchen-btn then fired only course 2. (2) Debt limit: client Иван Петров limit 50 — under-limit debt (8.10₽) paid with no modal; over-limit (projected 72.90 vs 50) opened debt-warn-modal with correct math, 'Отмена' aborted (checkout stayed open, no receipt), 'Всё равно провести' completed payment (backend debt = 72.90 verified). credit_limit=0 -> no warning. (3) Promo: seeded 'Счастливые часы −15%' shows 'все дни 15:00–18:00' and prefills 15:00/18:00 in edit modal; new promo with window 12:00–14:30 + weekdays Вт,Чт created, persisted after reload, deleted. Regressions OK: cash checkout, receipt modal, item comment rendering (cart-comment-0), course sorting. Test data cleaned up. Only open bug: Clients edit modal credit_limit prefill.
rca_of_the_issue: Clients.jsx edit-client onClick constructs a partial form object that excludes credit_limit; save() then coerces the missing value with `Number(form.credit_limit || 0)` and PUTs credit_limit: 0, overwriting the stored limit. Repro: /admin/clients -> pencil on a client with limit 50 -> field shows 0 -> Сохранить -> GET /api/clients returns credit_limit 0. Fix: spread the client row into the form state.
